root: Uni-CLI 0.225.1 is the site-availability and browser-substrate repair release: every adapter command is classified, every safe public site representative is probed, and concentrated failures are reported as actionable health data.

`npm run site:availability` now separates real adapter failures from auth gates, browser/CDP requirements, local daemon gaps, platform mismatches, quarantines, semantic-input requirements, and write/destructive commands.

Browser and Electron repair paths now surface catchable launch errors, declare `cdp-browser` capability requirements, and create fresh user-session CDP page targets instead of reusing stale logged-in tabs.

The release candidate was smoke-tested through the built CLI on Twitter/X, Xiaohongshu, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, and Weibo, then checked with adapter health, real E2E, unit, lint, release, verify, and npm dry-run gates.
zh: Uni-CLI 0.225.1 是站点可用性与浏览器 substrate 修复发布：每条 adapter 命令都会被分类，每个安全公开站点代表探针都会被实际执行，集中失败会变成可行动的 health data。
`npm run site:availability` 现在把真实 adapter 失败和 auth gate、browser/CDP 需求、本地 daemon 缺口、平台不匹配、quarantine、语义输入需求、写入/破坏性命令分开报告。
Browser 与 Electron 修复路径现在会暴露可捕获的 launch error，声明 `cdp-browser` capability requirement，并为 user-session CDP 创建 fresh page target，不再复用 stale 登录 tab。
这个 release candidate 已用 built CLI 跑过 Twitter/X、小红书、Reddit、YouTube、Bilibili、Weibo smoke，并经过 adapter health、real E2E、unit、lint、release、verify、npm dry-run gates。
